terms.definition: A set of technical standards developed by the W3C that define how to make web content more accessible to people with disabilities.
A W3C specification that defines a way to make web content and web applications more accessible to people with disabilities.
Communication that is clear, concise, and well-organized. In legal and regulatory contexts, plain language requirements may be mandated by law.
The use of HTML elements that convey meaning about the type of content they contain, beyond just presentation.
